disclaimer.short: Information and guidance grounded in cited sources — not legal advice, and not a substitute for a qualified professional.
disclaimer.prototype: Smart India Hackathon prototype · problem statement SIH26045. Not an official government service.

notAvailable.title: Not available yet
notAvailable.body: This screen shows where the feature will be. Nothing here works yet, and nothing shown here is legal information.
notAvailable.whenReady: When it is ready, this area will:

ask.title: Ask
ask.description: Ask a question about intellectual property or regulation for an Ayurvedic product.

points.one: Quote the official text each answer relies on, with its source and date.
points.two: Answer Indian and international material separately, never mixed together.
points.three: Say so when the sources do not support an answer, and offer a human facilitator instead.

classify.title: Classify
classify.description: Answer a few fixed questions about one of your products and see which category your answers lead to.

points.one: Ask about your product one question at a time, and show why each question was asked.
points.two: Show the category your own answers lead to — never a legal determination.

myProduct.title: My Product
myProduct.description: Describe your products. What you write here is your own description, not a classification.

points.one: Hold the product or formulation name, its ingredients and its intended purpose.
points.two: Hold formulation details and manufacturing information.
points.three: Hold source documents you choose to attach.

myProduct.note: A profile describes your product. It is never treated as a legal classification.

escalate.title: Escalate
escalate.description: When the sources are not enough, send your question to a person.

points.one: Send your question to a human IP facilitator.
points.two: Show the facilitator's reply as theirs, with their name and role.

incoming.title: Incoming escalations
incoming.description: Questions users have sent to a facilitator.

points.two: Show for each what the user asked, and what the sources did and did not support.

brief.title: Brief
brief.description: Everything about one escalation, in one place.

points.one: Bring together the question, the user's product profile and the sources already found.
Carry your replies to the user, shown as yours and with your role.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Your private notes on an escalation.

points.one: Keep working notes on an escalation that only facilitators can see.

corpus.title: Corpus
corpus.description: Official source documents and the provisions taken from them. Only approved text can ever be used.

points.one: List every official source document with its issuing authority, retrieval date and fingerprint.
points.two: Make sure only approved text is ever quoted to users.

upload.title: Upload
upload.description: Add an official source document and record where it came from.

points.one: Accept official source documents, and use none of them until they are approved.

drafts.title: Draft / Diff
drafts.description: Work in progress, and how each piece differs from what is already approved.

points.one: Set a proposed version of a provision beside the version it would replace.

approve.title: Approve
approve.description: Decide what enters the corpus. Nothing is used until it is approved here.

points.one: Show each submitted source and provision with its checksum, and record who approved it and when.
Add IP facilitators and show who is available.

landing.lead: A guide to intellectual property and regulation for Ayurvedic products — being built to answer from official sources, to show the exact text it relied on, and to keep Indian and international law apart.
landing.status: In development. Questions and classification are not available yet. Curators can now prepare the library of official sources; nothing from it is shown to users yet.
landing.areasTitle: What it is being built to do

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Use the account you were given. Your role decides what you see.
signIn.wrongProduct: This server is running a different product, so signing in here will not work.

lane.label: Lane
lane.hint: Indian and international material are kept apart. A record's lane is set once and never changes.

authority.label: Source authority
authority.hint: Only these official sources are accepted. Their reuse terms have not been verified.

issue.ocr_text_requires_verification: Some pages had no text layer and were read by OCR (machine transcription). Check them against the original.
issue.low_ocr_confidence: The OCR engine was unsure on some pages.
issue.page_without_text: Some pages yielded no text at all.
issue.ocr_unavailable: Some pages have no text layer, and no OCR engine was available to read them.

parseError.too_many_pages: The file has more pages than the limit. It was not read in part, because a partial text would look complete.
parseError.no_text_found: No text could be read from any page.
parseError.document_unreadable: The PDF could not be read.
parseError.incomplete_reading: Not every page could be read, so none of it was kept.
parseError.generic: The file could not be read.

list.empty: No source documents yet. Upload one to begin.
list.emptyLane: No source documents in this lane.

upload.instrumentHint: What this file is a text of: an Act, a set of Rules, a treaty.
upload.issuedByHint: The body that issued it, as the source names it.
upload.descriptionHint: Your own note about this record. Never statutory text.
upload.sourceUrlHint: Where you obtained the file. Recorded only — the server never opens it.
upload.sourceReferenceHint: A citation where there is no URL, such as a gazette number.
upload.fileHint: The file is stored exactly as uploaded. Nothing is read or approved until you choose to.
upload.provenanceNote: Give a URL, a reference, or both.

source.readHint: Copies the PDF's text layer exactly. Pages without one are read by the offline OCR engine and marked for checking.
source.emptyPage: No text was read from this page.
source.versionsTitle: Provision versions taken from this source
source.final: This decision is final. A correction is a new upload.

mark.title: Take a provision from this text
mark.help: Choose the first and last line of the provision. The text is copied exactly as read — nothing can be typed in.
mark.locator: Label as printed in the source
mark.locatorHint: For example 3(1), Article 15, or Schedule I item 4 — exactly as the source prints it.
mark.validityHint: When the source says this text applies. Both dates are inclusive. This is not the upload or approval date.

review.acknowledge: I checked the machine-read or missing text against the original file.
review.needsSource: Its source document must be approved first.

version.title: {locator} · version {number}
version.ocrWarning: Some of this text is OCR — machine transcription. Check it against the original before approving.
version.diffTitle: Compared with the last approved version
version.noBaseline: There is no earlier approved version of this provision. Every line is new.
version.statusNote: Each entry records what a cited source states, with that source. It is not the system's conclusion about the law.
version.basisHint: Give an approved source, a reference, or both.

diff.title: Compare
diff.noBaseline: There is no earlier approved source of this instrument. Every line is new.

classifier.title: Support for the classifier
classifier.help: Link this approved text to a reference the classifier rests on. Only approved text in the same lane can be linked, and the link is recorded.
classifier.linked: Linked. The reference is now verified.
classifier.listHelp: What the classifier's questions rest on, and whether approved text supports each one yet.

product.empty: You have not described a product yet.
product.factsNote: These are your facts about your product, kept as you write them. They are not a classification and not a legal determination.

field.name: Product or formulation name
field.intended_use: What it is for, in your words
field.administration_route: How it is taken or applied
field.classical_reference: Classical text or formulation it follows, if any

reference.verifiedNote: Linked by a curator to approved text in the source library.
reference.unverifiedNote: Linked, but to text that is not approved. It is not relied on.
reference.corpusRequiredNote: The official text for this has not been added to the source library yet, so nothing is cited.

purpose.question: What is the product's main purpose?
purpose.help: The purpose decides which group of rules the product is looked at under first.
purpose.why: Without it the classifier cannot tell which group of categories to consider.

classical_formula.question: Is the formula and method exactly as given in a text listed in the relevant First Schedule?
classical_formula.help: Answer yes only if you can name the listed text and the product follows its formula and method exactly.
classical_formula.missing: Whether the formula and method follow a listed text exactly.
classical_formula.why: This decides whether the product can be a classical formulation.

schedule_combination.question: Does it contain only ingredients from the relevant First Schedule, in a new combination, and is it not given by injection or infusion?
schedule_combination.help: Answer yes only if all three are true. If any one is not, answer no.
schedule_combination.missing: Whether every ingredient is from the First Schedule, whether the combination is new, and how the product is given.
schedule_combination.why: This decides whether the product can be a patent or proprietary formulation.

phytopharmaceutical.question: Is it a purified and standardised extract or fraction of a plant, with at least four defined markers?
phytopharmaceutical.help: Count only markers that are defined for this extract or fraction.
phytopharmaceutical.missing: Whether the product is a purified, standardised plant extract or fraction, and how many defined markers it has.
phytopharmaceutical.why: This decides whether the product can be a phytopharmaceutical.

slot.first_schedule: The First Schedule these questions refer to
slot.category_classical: The official description of a classical formulation
slot.category_patent_proprietary: The official description of a patent or proprietary formulation
slot.category_new_or_non_classical: The official basis for a new or non-classical formulation, if one exists
slot.category_phytopharmaceutical: The official description of a phytopharmaceutical
slot.category_ayurveda_aahara: The official description of Ayurveda Aahara
slot.category_cosmetic: The official description of a cosmetic

start.noProducts: Describe a product first, on My Product.

session.title: Classifying {product}
session.tree: Classifier version {version} · engineering draft, not yet legally reviewed
session.context: What you told us about the product
session.noContext: You have not described this yet.
session.stopBody: The classifier cannot determine a classification from the information available. Nothing has been assumed and no category has been chosen. Change the answer when you know more.
session.resultNote: This is the category the classifier's fixed questions lead to from your answers. It is not a legal determination, not an approval, and not advice.
session.rejectedNote: No other category was chosen in its place. To revise your answers, start again.
session.superseded: This classification was replaced by a newer one. It is kept as it was.
